name: – Mohammed Chahim – Article 1 – § 1 – point 1 – after point e – Am 103
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
section: Article 1 – paragraph 1 – point 1 – point e a (new)
part_text: (ea) the following paragraph is added: '12a. Notwithstanding paragraph 1, and at the request of a Member State, the Commission may exempt certain goods imported into an outermost region within the meaning of Article 349 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union from the application of this Regulation, provided that the following conditions are met: (a) the imported goods are intended exclusively for local use; (b) the exemption is necessary and proportionate in view of the structural constraints of the region concerned, as duly established by the requesting Member State; (c) the exemption does not undermine the coherence of the Union’s internal market.'
